not_found_hint: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or may have moved.
common_no_traffic_in_window: No traffic recorded in this window.
auth_registration_closed: Registration is currently closed. Ask an administrator for an invitation.
auth_verification_failed_send: Your account was created, but the verification email could not be sent. Please contact an administrator.
auth_verification_sent: We sent a verification link to your email. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.
auth_already_have_account: Already have an account? Sign in
auth_reset_email_sent_intro: If an account exists for that email, we sent a password reset link. Open it to choose a new password.
auth_reset_enter_email: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
auth_reset_link_invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
auth_sign_in_new_password: You can now sign in with your new password.
auth_email_verified_sign_in: You can now sign in to your account.
auth_verification_link_invalid: This verification link is invalid or has expired.
session_renewal_message: Session needs renewal. Reconnect to keep working without signing in again.
dashboard_no_nodes_hint: Add a node's API URL and secret to start collecting traffic.
settings_timezone_desc: Override the timezone used for charts and timestamps across the panel.
settings_passkeys_desc: Sign in without a password using a passkey stored on this device.
settings_ignored_ips_desc: These client IPs are excluded from recent-connection tracking for all users.
settings_invitation_system_desc: Generate invite codes for sign-ups. Requires open registration.
settings_open_registration_desc: Master switch for sign-ups. When off, no one can register.
settings_require_invite_desc: Sign-ups must present a valid code. Requires the invitation system.
settings_smtp_note: Sign-ups without a code must verify their email, which needs SMTP set up in the PocketBase admin. Until then, those sign-ups are rejected.
settings_database_desc: Keep traffic data from piling up over time.
settings_database_management_desc: View storage usage and prune old data points.
settings_management_api_desc: Let external services manage resources on this platform.
settings_mgmt_api_enabled_desc: The /api/mgmt/* endpoints are served, authenticated by a server-generated token.
settings_mgmt_api_disabled_desc: Turning this on generates a token shown once. Copy it before leaving this page.
settings_copy_token_now: Copy your token now. It won't be shown again.
settings_api_reference_desc: Endpoints with request and response examples.
settings_notification_channels_desc: Manage encrypted destinations for future panel notifications.
settings_notification_channels_manage_de: Add, test, and protect outgoing destinations.
notifications_intro: Manage encrypted Shoutrrr destinations. Channels do not send automatically until a future rule uses them.
notifications_empty_hint: Add an encrypted destination, test it, then enable it for future notification rules.
notifications_form_description: The URL is encrypted before storage. Saved URLs require a fresh passkey verification to reveal.
notifications_url_replace_hint: Leave blank to keep the saved URL. Replacing it clears the previous test result.
notifications_enabled_desc: Disabled channels may still be tested, but future rules will skip them.
notifications_delete_confirm: Delete {name} and permanently erase its encrypted URL? This cannot be undone.
notifications_reveal_description: This saved URL was revealed after a fresh passkey verification. Clear it when you are done.
notifications_passkey_required: Register a passkey in Settings to reveal saved channel URLs. You can still replace, test, enable, or delete this channel.
database_maintenance_meta: Deletes only traffic_hourly and traffic_daily rows
database_prune_confirm: Delete {count} traffic data points older than 30 days? This cannot be undone.
database_maintenance_eligible: Rows with {bucketField} before {cutoff} are eligible. Current eligible rows: {count}.
invitations_disabled_banner: The invitation system is off, so new codes can't be created or used.
invitations_create_description: Generates a shareable code. Set a usage limit and expiry, or leave them at 0 for unlimited / never.
invitations_email_description: Recorded for reference; the code works for any email.
invitations_email_invite_description: Send the link to the address above (requires SMTP configured).
invitations_delete_confirm: Delete invitation {code}? People who already have it can no longer use it.
analytics_no_node_traffic: No node traffic in this window.
mgmt_api_intro: HTTP endpoints for external services to look up and provision users. Enable the API on the Settings page; a token is generated and shown once.
mgmt_api_auth_bearer_intro: Send the configured token as a bearer token on every request:
mgmt_api_auth_disabled: While the API is turned off, every endpoint returns 404. A missing or invalid token returns 401.
mgmt_api_get_summary: Look up a single user by email or auth_string. Provide exactly one of the two.
mgmt_api_get_errors: 400 if both or neither parameter is sent. 404 if no user matches.
mgmt_api_post_summary: Create a user from an email. The password and auth_string are generated server-side and never returned; the account is created active and verified with the user role. Send the new user through the password reset flow to grant access.
mgmt_api_post_errors: 400 if the body is invalid, the email is missing, or the email is already taken.
mgmt_api_errors_shape: All errors share the same shape:
users_empty_hint: Create a user to issue a Hysteria auth key and track its traffic.
users_search_placeholder: Search email, role, status, or full auth key…
users_create_description: Create an account by email. The password and auth key are generated automatically and the account is verified immediately.
users_created_auth_key_hint: Copy the auth key for the client. The user can set a login password via the reset-password flow.
user_not_found_hint: It may have been deleted or moved.
user_manage_status_active_desc: User can sign in and connect to nodes.
user_manage_status_disabled_desc: Blocks new sign-ins and client connections. Existing sessions are kicked.
user_manage_reset_desc: Generate a new Hysteria auth key. The old key stops working immediately.
user_manage_reset_confirm_body: This replaces the current auth key. Connected clients must update their config.
user_manage_reset_new_key_hint: Copy the new key now. Clients must use it on the next connect.
user_passkeys_empty_hint_self: Add a passkey to sign in without typing your password.
user_passkeys_empty_hint_other: This account has not enrolled a passkey.
user_passkeys_delete_confirm_body: Passkey "{name}" will be removed. You won't be able to sign in with it anymore.
user_recent_connections_empty_hint: Successful Hysteria logins will appear here.
user_live_empty_snapshot_hint: Fetch a live snapshot to see this account's active streams across visible nodes.
user_live_no_nodes_hint: This account has no enabled nodes available for live diagnostics.
user_live_no_streams_hint: This account is not routing traffic through visible nodes right now.
nodes_add_description: Register a Hysteria or AnyTLS node's API endpoint to start collecting traffic.
nodes_add_api_url_description: The Traffic Stats API address (the `trafficStats` listen port, not the proxy port).
nodes_add_api_url_invalid: Enter a valid URL, e.g. https://node.example.com:8443
nodes_add_api_secret_description: Generate one or paste the node's secret, then copy it into the server config. Stored encrypted and hidden after saving.
nodes_add_poll_interval_invalid: Use a whole number of seconds, at least 1
nodes_add_enabled_description: Poll this node as soon as it's saved.
nodes_setup_intro: The panel only reads stats; it never deploys the node. Enable the Traffic Stats API in the node's server.yaml, then restart {protocol}.
nodes_setup_auth_intro: Point {protocol}'s auth.http.url at the panel. Each connect attempt is checked against the auth_string of the matching user; disabled accounts are rejected.
nodes_setup_host_note: Adjust the host if the node reaches the panel through a different URL than your browser does.
nodes_setup_yaml_note_listen: API address; must be reachable from the panel
nodes_setup_yaml_note_insecure: true only if the panel uses self-signed TLS
nodes_created_saved_note: The node was saved and will still be polled. You can retest it from the dashboard.
node_not_found_hint: It may have been deleted. Head back to the dashboard to see the current fleet.
node_reset_api_secret_desc: Generate a new secret for this node. Update the Hysteria server config before the next poll, or collection will fail.
node_reset_api_secret_confirm_body: This replaces the current API secret. The old value stops working immediately.
node_reset_api_secret_new_hint: Copy the new secret now. It will not be shown again.
node_delete_hint: Removes this node from the fleet and stops polling. Historical traffic data is kept.
node_delete_confirm: Delete node {name}? Historical traffic data will be kept.
node_delete_confirm_body: Node "{name}" will be removed from the fleet. This cannot be undone from the dashboard. Historical traffic data will be kept.
node_live_empty_snapshot_hint: Fetch a live snapshot to see every active stream on this node, grouped by user.
node_live_no_streams_hint: Nobody is routing traffic through this node right now.
error_network_default: Network error. Retrying on the next refresh.
error_database_prune_network: Network error while deleting old traffic data.
error_node_create_network: Network error while creating the node.
error_node_test_network: Network error while testing the node.
error_node_delete_network: Network error while deleting the node.
error_node_reset_api_secret_network: Network error while resetting the API secret.
error_mgmt_token_rotate: Couldn't rotate the management API token.
error_mgmt_token_rotate_network: Network error while rotating the management API token.
error_invitation_create_network: Network error while creating the invitation.
error_invitation_delete_network: Network error while deleting the invitation.
error_ignored_ip_create_network: Network error while ignoring this IP.
error_ignored_ip_delete_network: Network error while removing this ignored IP.
error_notification_channel_save_network: Network error while saving the notification channel.
error_notification_channel_delete_networ: Network error while deleting the notification channel.
error_notification_channel_test_network: Network error while testing the notification channel.
error_notification_channel_reveal: Couldn't reveal the notification channel URL.
error_user_create_network: Network error while creating the user.
error_user_update_network: Network error while updating the user.
error_user_reset_auth_network: Network error while resetting the auth key.
error_password_login_disabled: password login is disabled for accounts with passkeys
error_email_invalid_or_taken: The email is invalid or already in use.
